column1: # iri acceptance vectors, from the RFC 3987 example text.
# RFC 3987 §2.2 derives the IRI grammar from RFC 3986's by widening iunreserved
# and the ipchar family with ucschar. The code-point boundaries of those sets
# are covered by format_iri_ucschar_test.go and TestIRIRejectsC1Controls, and
# the official suite's optional/format/iri.json exercises them with invented
# non-ASCII strings. These rows are the RFC's own example IRIs, which neither
# carries, and the scheme-less forms an iri rejects.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
